name: cavemio-empty-state
title: Empty state
description: What a list says before there is anything in it: an isometric line drawing in your theme that draws itself, changes with the state and acts out the action.

cavemio.usage:
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";

<EmptyState
  scene="inbox"
  title="No projects yet"
  description="Start one and invite your team."
  action={{ label: "Create project", pendingLabel: "Creating", successLabel: "Created", onAction: createProject }}
/>
cavemio.accessibility:
- The drawing is decorative (aria-hidden); the title is a heading and the failure message is announced with role="alert".
- Status button announces Working, Done and Try again outside the button.
- Reduced motion: no drawing, rolling or shaking; scenes cross-fade and text changes in place.
- Below 22rem of container width the drawing shrinks from 168 to 132px wide and the padding tightens.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: scene
props.description: "inbox" · The drawing: nothing yet, no results, all done, can't connect or no data. Changing it redraws the object on the same tile.

props.name: illustration
props.description: – · Your own art in place of the drawing.

props.name: title
props.description: – · The headline; changes morph letter by letter.

props.name: description
props.description: – · A sentence or two under it; changes cross-fade.

props.name: action
props.type: { label, onAction?, pendingLabel?, successLabel?, errorLabel?, icon? } | ReactNode
props.description: – · The main action as a Status button whose pending, done and failed states the drawing acts out; onAction may return a promise and throws to fail. Or pass your own button.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: – · A quieter button or link beside it.

props.name: children
props.description: – · Anything under the text, such as suggested searches.

features.title: Art in your theme
features.description: Faces and lines are mixed from your shadcn tokens, so the drawing follows any brand in light and dark; pass illustration to use your own.

features.title: Five states, one tile
features.description: inbox, search, offline, chart and done share the tile; changing scene un-draws the old object and draws the new one.

features.title: Drawn when seen
features.description: Lines draw back to front and faces fill once the drawing is on screen, never while it is out of sight.

features.title: The action, acted out
features.description: onAction runs as Status button (Working → Done); the drawing moves into its pending and done poses with it.

features.title: Failures said in place
features.description: Throw from onAction: the piece springs back with a shake, the button says Try again and your message folds in.

features.title: Fits a card or a page
features.description: A container query shrinks the drawing and padding in narrow cards and table bodies.

states.title: first view
states.description: The tile draws itself, then the scene: each line traces in 640ms, 34ms after the one behind it, and its face fills over the last third.

states.title: scene change
states.description: The old object retracts front to back in 340ms while the new one draws in 160ms later; the tile stays.

states.title: title and description
states.description: The title morphs through TextMorph; the description lifts out through a 4px blur as the new one rises in, and the height eases over 380ms.

states.title: action running
states.description: The button shows its spinner and pending label; the hero piece eases to its pending pose (the sheet lowers, the plug moves toward the socket).

states.title: action done
states.description: The check draws in the button and the piece lands in its done pose with a slight settle (620ms).

states.title: action failed
states.description: The piece returns and shakes ±4px, the button says Try again, and the thrown message folds in under it.
